scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=@call-center-radar/web" "./.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir apps/api/src --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@call-center-radar/web && PYTHONPATH=apps/api/src ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest apps/api
scripts.test:trust: PYTHONPATH=apps/api/src ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest -ra apps/api/tests/test_priority.py apps/api/tests/test_validation.py apps/api/tests/test_false_resolution.py apps/api/tests/test_evidence.py apps/api/tests/test_api_contracts.py apps/api/tests/test_pipeline.py --cov=app.priority --cov=app.validation --cov=app.false_resolution --cov=app.evidence --cov=app.pipeline --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=90
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace=@call-center-radar/web && PYTHONPATH=apps/api/src ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest apps/api --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=xml:coverage/api-coverage.xml
